Fixture grid over time

51 samples. Now: 473 full, 420 partial, 1287 of 1977 built (the same numbers as the summary above).

  • Full 2/2 every feature rebuilt as an editable timeline, and the shape matches the original design
  • Partial 2/3 an editable timeline with some of the features rebuilt (the cell says how many)
  • Geometry the shape opens and was compared, or was placed without an editable timeline
  • Failing the file did not open or could not be compared
  • Awaiting built; Dutchman can't read this file type yet
  • – not built yet
  • n/a hatched: not part of that program's recipe set (not counted in its totals)
  • dev measured with an unreleased Dutchman development build; it changes when a release reads that program

What changed

  • 2026-11-23: results that place the shape without editable history now read Geometry only, not Failing.
